approved: Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law Amendment Bill 2014

Introduced amendments to the Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law Act 2012, agreed by all state and territory transport ministers, to give the national regulator more discretion over vessel certificate suspensions and align the definition of 'defence vessel' with the Navigation Act 2012.

Said the Greens would not block the Marine Safety (Domestic Commercial Vessel) National Law Amendment Bill 2014 from passing the House, but flagged concerns about section 11's delegation of authority and its effect on appeal rights, to be examined further as the bill proceeds to the Senate.
